tasks.title: Owners edit status settings and create compatible service tokens
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Status page/shared read-write/token/navigation files and associated Checks; R3 Status page/shared rules; R2 status admin routes; Decisions 4-5, 15-16; Risks/Rollout (old token validator). Pin merged contract 2.4.0. Deliver Owner-only /status-page form, optional/three-way fields, 25 theme-token names with light/dark color tables, four flags and keyboard Move up/Move down/Reset component order. Fresh reports lock individual fields with origin; stale/never overrides unknown remain DB-editable; reject forged locked writes before forwarding. Implement shared HTTP reads/writes in the existing check pattern with contract 5-MiB read limit, metadata-only outcomes, no retries/redirects, 412 input retention, saved/unknown People log, role recheck at commit, form tokens and 65536-byte forms. Add both sole-scope service token presets/missingScope->admin and strict token-list compatibility. Register only delivered screen navigation; T2 adds Notifications. Update docs and browser fixtures with this screen.

acceptance.command: bun test src/server.status-page.test.ts src/runtime-read.test.ts src/runtime-write.test.ts src/navigation.test.ts src/icons.test.ts src/people-log.test.ts src/token-view.test.ts src/token-read.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Owner saves status values; Admin/Member/Viewer receive literal 403 on direct GET/POST; role change before commit 403. Invalid Origin/CSRF 403, replay 409, oversized 65536-byte form 413. Locked fields have origin text and forged change 422 with 0 API calls. Three-way flags and clearing optional fields preserve intended absence. Stale/never keeps DB fields editable with overrides-unknown banner; rejected and appliedRevision mismatch show specified states. 412 retains input; rejected token/old API 404/invalid/timeout have states; saved and unknown outcomes write People log without values/references. Reads use contract 5-MiB limit; writes infer outcome from metadata, send Bearer and quoted If-Match once with 5000-ms timeout. Notify token list renders; Status service=[status], Notify service=[notify], both grant only through admin.
exit 0; keyboard-only Move up/Move down/Reset of 3 components saves the literal intended order, and existing browser/a11y fixtures pass.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

tasks.title: Owners manage notification channels and resend failed events with stable request ids
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Notifications files/behavior, remaining Checks and Completion evidence; R3 Notifications/shared rules; R2 notify admin routes; Decisions 4-5, 12, 14-16; Security impact; Acceptance evidence 2. Extend T1 shared helpers with channel list/new/edit/delete, failed list and resend-state page plus Owner-only navigation/icons. File channels show only id/type/refs/origin and overflow total; shadowed DB copies allow only delete, stale origins stay unknown. Editors offer transport/routing fields and secret reference names only, env-prefix and secret-directory guidance, zero-channel state and channel-limit handling. Failed list shows newest <=200 plus total, Resend only with payload. Generate 24-char base64url requestId when rendering the form and preserve it after unknown/timeout so a deliberate retry sends the same id; respect replayed form token 409. Configuration writes need If-Match; resend does not. Limit delete/resend forms to 8192 bytes and status/channel forms to 65536. People log actions/targets, saved/unknown outcomes, all denial/stale/old-api/rejected/error states and docs must be complete.

acceptance.command: bun test src/server.notifications.test.ts src/runtime-read.test.ts src/runtime-write.test.ts src/navigation.test.ts src/icons.test.ts src/people-log.test.ts src/server.status-page.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Owner creates/edits/deletes/resends and reads command state; Admin/Member/Viewer get 403 on GET/POST of every new path and role downgrade before write gives 403. Invalid Origin/CSRF 403 and replay token 409; body caps 8192/65536 yield 413 beyond. File views offer 0 edits; shadowed DB offers Delete only; overflow totals and stale/never/rejected/not-applied/zero-channel states render. 412 retains input, old-api 404/token rejection/422 limit/503 resend show states. No secret-value form exists and forged url is never forwarded. Two sends around a fake-API timeout use 2 equal requestIds of 24 base64url characters while form tokens stay single-use; only payload rows offer Resend. Configuration carries quoted If-Match, resend requires none; metadata determines outcomes; People log has prescribed actions/targets for saved/unknown and 0 settings/reference/secret values.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.
exit 0; all browser/a11y fixture pages including Status page and Notifications pass; keyboard-only reorder of 3 components and save still works.

PR contains check/browser outputs, new tests failing on fc2c166 then passing, applicable Security impact checklist with Owner/commit guard, Origin/CSRF/replay and form-size checks, contract parsing/read bounds, unknown-outcome retry id, reference-only/no-secret assertions, redirects/pin evidence. Include manual bun start against local API with screenshots of both screens and observed save/delete/resend behavior. Document update-console-before-service-token rollout and full/dev showChecks lock.
